articles.title: In Germany the mood is dark. But the Weimar narrative is a far right trap | Klaus Brinkbäumer
articles.summary:
The final season of the TV epic Babylon Berlin is taking us back to 1933. Our confidence is falling apart, but that’s where the parallels end

There is one experience we in Germany can all find mildly satisfying this autumn, as we watch the dark and terrifying final season of the hit TV series Babylon Berlin. We know everything those fearless (a few of them) or frightened (many more) and opportunistic (the majority) people on the screen do not. We know their future.

Made by the public broadcaster ARD, Babylon Berlin has run for over 10 years, brilliantly fictionalising how Germany sleepwalked into nazism and the second world war. The fifth and last season begins in January 1933 with Adolf Hitler appointed Reichskanzler.

Four years ago, this field in eastern Ukraine was occupied by Russian soldiers. Now back under Ukrainian control, it is littered with landmines. Civilians such as Kabanova are trying to make the land usable again.

articles.title: The fall of Germany’s ex-spymaster – podcast
articles.summary:
A former head of Germany’s foreign intelligence service has been accused of selling classified documents. Kate Connolly reports on the fallout

Just before 9am last Tuesday morning, police swarmed a red brick house in Nordwalde, close to the Dutch border in western Germany. It looked like a terror operation, with masked officers entering the property en masse.

But when they emerged with their suspect, he wasn’t even handcuffed. Perhaps it was his age. Or maybe his reputation. Because the white-haired 80-year-old being taken into custody was August Hanning, the former head of Germany’s spy agency, the BND.

Centrální banky a trhy mezitím vstřebávají dopady amerických sankcí a obchodních třenic na globální energetické komodity.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces a complex crisis involving escalating security tensions in Ukraine and the Middle East, a political shift to the right ahead of key elections, and structural economic challenges including cyberattacks on critical infrastructure. Meanwhile, central banks and markets are absorbing the impacts of US sanctions and trade frictions on global energy commodities.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zvýšenou nervozitu na trzích kvůli politické nestabilitě, kybernetickým hrozbám na infrastrukturu a přetrvávajícím debatám o energetických sankcích a příměří.
archive.forecast_en: Increased market nervousness is expected over the coming days due to political instability, cyber threats to infrastructure, and ongoing debates over energy sanctions and ceasefires.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícím se bezpečnostním rizikům kvůli pokračujícím útokům na ukrajinskou energetickou infrastrukturu navzdory údajným příměřím a rostoucímu napětí kolem černomořské dopravy. Politická nestabilita se projevuje v protestech, vnitřních sporech v EU a přetrvávajících debatách o financování obrany a využití zmrazených ruských aktiv. Makroekonomické prostředí zůstává poznamenáno obavami z inflace, vývojem úrokových sazeb ECB a politickými třenicemi ohledně zelené transformace.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating security risks due to ongoing attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure despite reported ceasefires and rising tensions surrounding Black Sea shipping. Political instability is manifesting through protests, internal EU disputes, and persistent debates over defense funding and the use of frozen Russian assets. The macroeconomic environment remains marked by inflation concerns, ECB interest rate trajectories, and political friction over the green transition.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na energetických trzích a diplomatické přetahované kvůli nedávným útokům na infrastrukturu na Ukrajině a v Černém moři.
archive.forecast_en: Continued volatility in energy markets and diplomatic tug-of-wars over recent infrastructure attacks in Ukraine and the Black Sea are expected in the coming days.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícímu se bezpečnostnímu napětí v důsledku probíhající války na Ukrajině, která se rozšiřuje do kyberprostoru a kritické infrastruktury, včetně nedávných útoků na ruská datová centra a soudních procesů kvůli sabotáži Nord Streamu. Politická nestabilita roste vlivem sílících protestů ve Francii a politických tlaků krajní pravice napříč kontinentem, zatímco makroekonomické prostředí zatěžují rostoucí výdaje na obranu a utahování rozpočtů.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing escalating security tensions driven by the ongoing war in Ukraine, which is spilling over into cyberspace and critical infrastructure, including recent attacks on Russian data centers and trials over the Nord Stream sabotage. Political instability is growing due to intensifying protests in France and rising far-right political pressure across the continent, while the macroeconomic environment is strained by surging defense spending and tightening budgets.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující napětí v kybernetické bezpečnosti, eskalaci protestů ve Francii a zostřenou rétoriku ohledně evropské obranné připravenosti.
archive.forecast_en: Continued cybersecurity tensions, escalating protests in France, and sharpened rhetoric regarding European defense readiness are expected in the coming days.
